with cs as (
    select zip, city, st, count(*) as n from (
        select zip_code_prefix as zip, city, state_code as st from "iceberg"."silver"."customers"
        union all select zip_code_prefix, city, state_code from "iceberg"."silver"."sellers") u
    where zip is not null group by zip, city, st
),
city_mode as (
    select zip, city from (select zip, city, row_number() over (partition by zip order by n desc, city) as r
                           from (select zip, city, sum(n) as n from cs where city is not null group by zip, city)) where r = 1
),
st_mode as (
    select zip, st from (select zip, st, row_number() over (partition by zip order by n desc, st) as r
                         from (select zip, st, sum(n) as n from cs where st is not null group by zip, st)) where r = 1
),
other as (select z.zip, c.city, s.st from (select distinct zip from cs) z left join city_mode c on c.zip = z.zip left join st_mode s on s.zip = z.zip),
z as (
    select coalesce(g.zip_code_prefix, o.zip) as zip, coalesce(g.city, o.city) as city, coalesce(g.state_code, o.st) as st, g.latitude, g.longitude
    from "iceberg"."silver"."geolocation_zip" g full join other o on o.zip = g.zip_code_prefix
),
x as (
    select z.*, r.state_name, r.region, m.ibge_code, i.microrregiao, i.mesorregiao, p16.population as p16, p17.population as p17, p18.population as p18,
           coalesce(m.method, 'unmatched') as match_method
    from z
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."state_region" r on r.state_code = z.st
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."city_ibge_match" m on m.state_code = z.st and m.city = z.city
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."ibge_municipio" i on i.ibge_code = m.ibge_code
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."ibge_population" p16 on p16.ibge_code = m.ibge_code and p16.year = 2016
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."ibge_population" p17 on p17.ibge_code = m.ibge_code and p17.year = 2017
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."ibge_population" p18 on p18.ibge_code = m.ibge_code and p18.year = 2018
)
select cast(row_number() over (order by zip) as integer) as geography_key, zip as zip_code_prefix, city, st as state_code,
       coalesce(state_name, 'Unknown') as state_name, coalesce(region, 'Unknown') as region, 'Brazil' as country, latitude, longitude,
       cast(ibge_code as integer) as ibge_municipio_code, microrregiao, mesorregiao,
       cast(p16 as integer) as populacao_2016, cast(p17 as integer) as populacao_2017, cast(p18 as integer) as populacao_2018, match_method
from x
union all

with o as (
    select order_id, customer_id, order_status, dq_flag_count as ods_flags,
           cast(order_purchase_timestamp as timestamp(6)) as purchase_ts, cast(order_approved_at as timestamp(6)) as approved_ts, cast(order_delivered_carrier_date as timestamp(6)) as carrier_ts,
           cast(order_delivered_customer_date as timestamp(6)) as delivered_ts, cast(order_estimated_delivery_date as timestamp(6)) as estimated_ts
    from "iceberg"."silver"."orders"
),
it as (
    select order_id, count(*) as item_count, count(distinct seller_id) as seller_count, sum(price) as order_value, sum(freight_value) as freight_total
    from "iceberg"."silver"."order_items" group by order_id
),
pm as (select order_id, sum(payment_value) as payment_total from "iceberg"."silver"."order_payments" group by order_id),
base as (
    select o.order_id, o.order_status, o.ods_flags, o.purchase_ts, o.approved_ts, o.carrier_ts, o.delivered_ts, o.estimated_ts,
           coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) as customer_key, coalesce(dc.geography_key, -1) as customer_geography_key, coalesce(os.order_status_key, -1) as order_status_key,
           date_diff('second', o.purchase_ts, o.approved_ts) as approval_s, date_diff('second', o.approved_ts, o.carrier_ts) as handling_s,
           date_diff('second', o.carrier_ts, o.delivered_ts) as transit_s, date_diff('second', o.purchase_ts, o.delivered_ts) as lead_s,
           date_diff('day', cast(o.estimated_ts as date), cast(o.delivered_ts as date)) as delay_days,
           date_diff('day', cast(o.purchase_ts as date), cast(o.estimated_ts as date)) as promised_raw,
           coalesce(it.item_count, 0) as item_count, coalesce(it.seller_count, 0) as seller_count, coalesce(it.order_value, 0) as order_value,
           coalesce(it.freight_total, 0) as freight_total, coalesce(pm.payment_total, 0) as payment_total
    from o
    join "iceberg"."silver"."customers" c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_customer" dc on dc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id and cast(o.purchase_ts as date) between dc.effective_from and dc.effective_to
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_order_status" os on os.order_status = o.order_status
    left join it on it.order_id = o.order_id
    left join pm on pm.order_id = o.order_id
),
b2 as (
    select base.*, case when order_status = 'delivered' and delivered_ts is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_delivered,
           (case when approval_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end) + (case when handling_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end) + (case when transit_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end)
           + (case when lead_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end) + (case when promised_raw < 0 then 1 else 0 end) as neg_count
    from base
)
select order_id, customer_key, customer_geography_key, order_status_key,
       (case when purchase_ts is null or cast(purchase_ts as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(purchase_ts, '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) as purchase_date_key, (case when approved_ts is null or cast(approved_ts as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(approved_ts, '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) as approved_date_key, (case when carrier_ts is null or cast(carrier_ts as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(carrier_ts, '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) as carrier_date_key,
       (case when delivered_ts is null or cast(delivered_ts as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(delivered_ts, '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) as delivered_date_key, (case when estimated_ts is null or cast(estimated_ts as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(estimated_ts, '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) as estimated_date_key,
       purchase_ts, approved_ts, carrier_ts, delivered_ts, estimated_ts,
       case when approval_s >= 0 then (cast((200 * (approval_s) + 3600) / (2 * 3600) as decimal(18, 0)) * 0.01) end as approval_hours,
       case when handling_s >= 0 then (cast((200 * (handling_s) + 86400) / (2 * 86400) as decimal(18, 0)) * 0.01) end as handling_days,
       case when transit_s >= 0 then (cast((200 * (transit_s) + 86400) / (2 * 86400) as decimal(18, 0)) * 0.01) end as transit_days,
       case when lead_s >= 0 then (cast((200 * (lead_s) + 86400) / (2 * 86400) as decimal(18, 0)) * 0.01) end as lead_days,
       delay_days, case when promised_raw >= 0 then promised_raw end as promised_days,
       is_delivered, case when is_delivered = 1 and delay_days > 0 then 1 else 0 end as is_late, case when order_status = 'canceled' then 1 else 0 end as is_canceled,
       item_count, seller_count, order_value, freight_total, payment_total, ods_flags + neg_count as dq_flag_count
from b2

select p.order_id, p.payment_sequential, (case when cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as timestamp(6)) is null or cast(cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as timestamp(6)) as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1

with gmv90 as (
    select f.seller_key, sum(f.price) as gmv
    from "iceberg"."gold"."fact_order_item" f
    join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_seller" s on s.seller_key = f.seller_key and s.first_sale_date is not null and s.is_from_funnel
    join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_date" dd on dd.date_key = f.purchase_date_key
    join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_order_status" os on os.order_status_key = f.order_status_key and os.status_group <> 'Failed'
    where dd.full_date >= s.first_sale_date and dd.full_date < date_add('day', 90, s.first_sale_date)
    group by f.seller_key
),
t as (
    select m.mql_id, m.landing_page_id, (case when cast(m.first_contact_date as timestamp(6)) is null or cast(cast(m.first_contact_date as timestamp(6)) as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(cast(m.first_contact_date as timestamp(6)), '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) as first_contact_date_key,
           case when d.mql_id is null then -1 else (case when cast(d.won_date as timestamp(6)) is null or cast(cast(d.won_date as timestamp(6)) as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(cast(d.won_date as timestamp(6)), '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) end as won_date_key,
           case when s.first_sale_date is null then -1 else (case when cast(s.first_sale_date as timestamp(6)) is null or cast(cast(s.first_sale_date as timestamp(6)) as date) not between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31' then -1
          else cast(date_format(cast(s.first_sale_date as timestamp(6)), '%Y%m%d') as integer) end) end as first_sale_date_key,
           coalesce(lo.lead_origin_key, -1) as lead_origin_key, coalesce(lp.lead_profile_key, -1) as lead_profile_key,
           coalesce(s.seller_key, -1) as seller_key, coalesce(sdr.sales_rep_key, -1) as sdr_key, coalesce(sr.sales_rep_key, -1) as sr_key,
           case when d.mql_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_won, case when s.first_sale_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as has_first_sale,
           date_diff('day', m.first_contact_date, cast(d.won_date as date)) as close_raw, date_diff('day', cast(d.won_date as date), s.first_sale_date) as sale_raw,
           d.declared_product_catalog_size, d.declared_monthly_revenue,
           case when s.first_sale_date is null then null else coalesce(g.gmv, 0) end as seller_gmv_first_90d
    from "iceberg"."silver"."mql" m
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_lead_origin" lo on lo.origin = m.origin
    left join "iceberg"."silver"."closed_deals" d on d.mql_id = m.mql_id
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_seller" s on s.seller_id = d.seller_id
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_lead_profile" lp on lp.business_segment = d.business_segment and lp.lead_type = d.lead_type
         and lp.lead_behaviour_profile = d.lead_behaviour_profile and lp.business_type = d.business_type
         and lp.has_company = d.has_company and lp.has_gtin = d.has_gtin and lp.average_stock = d.average_stock
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_sales_rep" sdr on sdr.rep_id = d.sdr_id and sdr.rep_role = 'SDR'
    left join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_sales_rep" sr on sr.rep_id = d.sr_id and sr.rep_role = 'SR'
    left join gmv90 g on g.seller_key = s.seller_key
)
select mql_id, landing_page_id, first_contact_date_key, won_date_key, first_sale_date_key, lead_origin_key, lead_profile_key, seller_key, sdr_key, sr_key,
       is_won, has_first_sale, case when close_raw >= 0 then close_raw end as days_to_close, case when sale_raw >= 0 then sale_raw end as days_won_to_first_sale,
       declared_product_catalog_size, declared_monthly_revenue, seller_gmv_first_90d
from t

with c as (
    select p.category_group, p.category_name_en, sum(f.price) as gmv, count(distinct f.order_id) as orders, count(*) as items
    from "iceberg"."gold"."fact_order_item" f
    join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_product" p on p.product_key = f.product_key

r as (

           100.0 * sum(gmv) over (order by gmv desc, category_name_en) / sum(gmv) over () as cum_share_pct
    from c
)
select gmv_rank, category_group, category_name_en, orders, items, gmv, round(share_pct, 2) as share_pct, round(cum_share_pct, 2) as cum_share_pct,

with it as (
    select f.seller_key, date_trunc('month', dd.full_date) as m, f.order_id, f.price, f.freight_value, os.status_group
    from "iceberg"."gold"."fact_order_item" f
    join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_date" dd on dd.date_key = f.purchase_date_key
    join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_order_status" os on os.order_status_key = f.order_status_key
    where f.seller_key <> -1 and f.purchase_date_key <> -1
),
ord as (
    select i.seller_key, i.m, i.order_id, coalesce(max(fo.is_delivered), 0) as is_delivered, coalesce(max(fo.is_late), 0) as is_late, coalesce(max(fo.is_canceled), 0) as is_canceled
    from it i left join "iceberg"."gold"."fact_order_fulfillment" fo on fo.order_id = i.order_id
    group by i.seller_key, i.m, i.order_id
),
sel as (select seller_key, min(m) as first_m from it group by seller_key),
lastm as (select max(m) as last_m from it),
grid as (select s.seller_key, g.m from sel s cross join lastm l cross join unnest(sequence(s.first_m, l.last_m, interval '1' month)) as g(m)),
a_it as (
    select seller_key, m, count(*) as items, sum(price) filter (where status_group <> 'Failed') as gmv, sum(freight_value) filter (where status_group <> 'Failed') as freight
    from it group by seller_key, m
),
a_ord as (
    select seller_key, m, count(*) as orders, sum(is_delivered) as delivered_orders, sum(is_late) as late_orders, sum(is_canceled) as canceled_orders
    from ord group by seller_key, m
),
a_rev as (
    select o.seller_key, o.m, avg(cast(r.review_score as decimal(10, 4))) as avg_score
    from ord o join "iceberg"."gold"."fact_review" r on r.order_id = o.order_id group by o.seller_key, o.m
)
select cast(date_format(g.m, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as month_date_key, g.seller_key,
       cast(coalesce(ao.orders, 0) as integer) as orders, cast(coalesce(ai.items, 0) as integer) as items, coalesce(ai.gmv, 0) as gmv, coalesce(ai.freight, 0) as freight,
       cast(coalesce(ao.delivered_orders, 0) as integer) as delivered_orders, cast(coalesce(ao.late_orders, 0) as integer) as late_orders,
       case when ao.delivered_orders > 0 then round(cast(ao.late_orders as decimal(18, 4)) / ao.delivered_orders, 4) end as late_rate,
       cast(coalesce(ao.canceled_orders, 0) as integer) as canceled_orders, round(ar.avg_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
       case when coalesce(ao.orders, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as is_active,
       case when ds.first_sale_date is not null then cast((year(g.m) - year(ds.first_sale_date)) * 12 + month(g.m) - month(ds.first_sale_date) as integer) end as months_since_first_sale
from grid g
join "iceberg"."gold"."dim_seller" ds on ds.seller_key = g.seller_key
left join a_it ai on ai.seller_key = g.seller_key and ai.m = g.m
left join a_ord ao on ao.seller_key = g.seller_key and ao.m = g.m
left join a_rev ar on ar.seller_key = g.seller_key and ar.m = g.m
